name: Clear Windows Update Cache
description: Clears cached Windows Update download files and temporary update data to resolve stuck downloads or free up disk space. Note that some updates may need to be downloaded again after the cache is cleared.

description_i18n.en: Clears cached Windows Update download files and temporary update data to resolve stuck downloads or free up disk space. Note that some updates may need to be downloaded again after the cache is cleared.
description_i18n.de: Leert zwischengespeicherte Windows-Update-Downloads und temporäre Updatedaten, um hängende Downloads zu beheben oder Speicherplatz freizugeben. Beachten Sie: Einige Updates müssen nach dem Leeren erneut heruntergeladen werden.
description_i18n.fr: Vide les fichiers de téléchargement et les données temporaires des mises à jour Windows pour résoudre des problèmes ou libérer de l'espace disque. Notez que certaines mises à jour devront être redéchargées après le nettoyage.

warnings.title: Update files removed
warnings.message: Cached update downloads are deleted. Some updates may need to be downloaded again after the cache is cleared

warnings.title: Service state change
warnings.message: Related Windows services may stop or restart briefly while the action runs

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Stops the Windows Update and BITS services, removes cached download data from SoftwareDistribution\Download, then restarts those services
